subject: What’s keeping that bed decision open?
preheader: Let’s work through the next step while there’s time before Christmas.
sectionTitle: We can pick it up from here
body: If we already have the brief or quote, just send the reference. Add the date the person needs the equipment in place.
We’ll help work through the options, check availability and work out the next step.
actionTitle: Allow time to act on the trial
actionText: If Christmas is the goal, starting that work now gives us more room to respond to what the trial shows.
ctaLabel: DISCUSS A BED OR MATTRESS NEED
teamName: The Sleep Choice x Supply Ministry Team
trialFooterText: Seven-night in-home trial availability, service area, equipment configuration and individual arrangements are confirmed per case.
intro: If a bed or mattress decision is still unresolved, reply with a few de-identified lines about what is holding it up.
It could be the equipment choice, a trial that needs another look or a quote that needs updating.
actionLead: Seven nights at home may be followed by an OT review, equipment changes, funding decisions and delivery arrangements.
